role_map.comparison: an original one-eyed cave giant symbolizing a cumbersome workflow
role_map.product: an original sea-worn strategist symbolizing InkClawAgent

panels.scene: Original mythic cave, huge one-eyed stone-skinned giant blocks the only exit; scattered task scrolls and tangled ropes suggest workflow friction.
panels.caption: work巴迪：进来了？那就慢慢绕。

panels.scene: The giant piles more gates, forms and ropes in front of the trapped crew; composition becomes intentionally absurd rather than violent.
panels.caption: 活没少干，出口还是没看见。

panels.scene: An original weather-beaten strategist arrives with a small glowing multi-agent tactical map; the crew follows a clever alternate route while the giant is confused.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：谁说一定要跟它硬耗？

panels.scene: Crew sails out into daylight while the giant is left arguing with its own maze of ropes and forms; no copied film framing or actor likeness.
panels.caption: 还得是 InkClawAgent 会破局。

visual_guardrails: Do not recreate Nolan film frames, costumes, poster layout, studio marks or title treatment.
Use generic mythic-voyage and cyclopean-cave archetypes with original character design.

briefs.topic: Niu Lai viral low-budget animation phenomenon

evidence.note: Financial Times reported the low-budget Chinese animation becoming a viral success, with memes and AI parodies contributing to its spread.

briefs.comparison_target: 热门单点 AI 工具
briefs.conflict: Polished-looking complexity versus a scrappy result-first approach; the joke is about workflow theater, not a benchmark claim.

role_map.comparison: an over-engineered glossy machine with too many decorative controls
role_map.product: a deliberately simple original paper-cut style operator representing InkClawAgent

panels.scene: A giant glossy AI control room with hundreds of blinking buttons; workers admire the interface.
panels.caption: 看起来：电影级生产力。

panels.scene: The workers are still manually copying the same brief between windows while the machine asks for another setting.
panels.caption: 实际：还在来回复制粘贴。

panels.scene: A rough, original, intentionally low-fi operator opens InkClawAgent and sends several specialized agents to brainstorm, review and execute in parallel.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：先把活干完再说。

panels.scene: Finished deliverables roll out while the glossy machine is still showing a loading animation; visual style is original and does not reproduce Niu Lai characters.
panels.caption: 工具可以很精致，工作流得真能跑。

visual_guardrails: Do not reproduce Niu Lai character designs, scenes or promotional art.
Borrow only the current cultural conversation around intentionally rough versus polished aesthetics.
No objective speed claim unless benchmark evidence is later attached.

evidence.note: Reuters reported Unitree CEO Wang Xingxing saying robotics is approaching a 'ChatGPT moment', while also cautioning that major software breakthroughs could still be years away.

briefs.conflict: A robot body has many limbs but no coordinated plan; the product metaphor is an orchestration brain rather than a stronger robot claim.

role_map.comparison: a room full of capable but uncoordinated robot arms
role_map.product: an original mission-control conductor representing InkClawAgent multi-agent orchestration

panels.scene: Futuristic workshop: many humanoid robots each hold one tool and wait for separate instructions.
panels.caption: 每个都能干一点。

panels.scene: A manager runs between robots repeating prompts and manually moving outputs from one station to another.
panels.caption: 但你成了最忙的那个 Agent。

panels.scene: InkClawAgent appears as an original mission-control layer, assigning brainstorm, writing, review and coding roles to a coordinated team.
panels.caption: InkClawAgent：别一个个喊，组队干。

panels.scene: The workshop runs as one coordinated production line; the human manager finally sits down with coffee.
panels.caption: 真正省事的，是不用你当调度员。
